svg.title: Kitsune Living Lineages — structurally faithful demonstration sheet
svg.desc: Editable 1536 by 1024 vector layout. Upper sequence shows exactly one shared Species Reference followed by Ember Rank 1 through Rank 9, including Rank 5 Hunter. Lower matrix shows Species Reference and Ranks 1, 2, 3 for Ember, Moonlit, Jade, Obsidian. Twenty-six display slots resolve to nineteen unique image assets. This structural template contains no recreated or fabricated pet artwork.
